audit_status: Original E00 PARTIAL; isolated repaired E00 PASS subject Human review
main_question: Can actual Work AI use one persistent Session, select a lawful object/model, receive real engine output, then choose a new legal experiment or STOP?
scientific_question: For an AI-selected bounded object, what model-defined energy/force information is available, and what additional measurement is worth the remaining budget? No discovery claim is prespecified.
baseline: Three historical StateKinds plus mature molecular/PBC/effective/FCI worker assets; unified API is offline validated, not a proven in-session autonomous scientist.
route_selected: A: adaptive cross-object molecular/periodic Session with typed energy/force semantics
not_a_new_physical_engine: Mature PySCF mean-field and PBC paths; no custom molecular solver

molecular.static_screen: Reuse foundation01 validator; no collision<0.35Angstrom; no new molecular-specific branch

periodic.object: One-atom neutral FCC Ne primitive cell, fixed conventional orientation

StateKind: QW_PHYSICAL_STATE_01 only for both BO branches; two different observable/boundary/model semantics. Do NOT claim two wavefunction types were evolved.
first_choice: After a Human domain approval, actual B-Work AI picks object, model and coordinates within envelope; records>=2 candidates incl STOP and reasons, prior information, prediction/falsifier before first run. This candidate does not invent that future decision.
first_information_goal: Determine whether typed source->request->native worker->bounded Observation->Session round trip works with real numerical uncertainty, and whether returned quantities change next resource choice.
predictions_frozen_now: Allowed objects must route to the applicable mature worker, without claiming missing observables
Converged mean-field returns finite energy in declared reference and molecular force vectors only where actually computed
Cross-domain absolute energy ranking and missing force requests must be rejected
hypothesis_before_first_observation: The specific AI-selected physical question and any directional/numeric forecast must be frozen in the first request before solver launch; inability to do so is INCOMPLETE, not filled retrospectively.
second_actions: CHANGE_OBJECT within approved same/cross domain envelope, may change molecular geometry by constructing a new WorldSpec
MEASURE_OBSERVABLE on an unchanged eligible WorldSpec only if a distinct justified information question remains
SWITCH_MODEL only as a recorded stop/nomination unless within already approved molecular/PBC combinations
second_action_policy: Not scripted. Requires real phase1 returned Observation hash, read trace, model limits,>=2 competing actions and rationales; no solver failure creates entitlement to second Job.

allowed: Explicit geometry-only projection with electronic-state information loss
Same composition/model/reference numerical comparison under explicit contract
forbidden: cross-composition or cross-PBC/molecule absolute energy ranking

molecular: SCF converged at inherited1e-10 threshold, max80 cycles
finite total BO energy and N-by3 analytic forces
report force sum as translational consistency screen at1e-5 Eh/bohr; screen failure -> UNVERIFIED, no retries
finite basis and RHF model error remain uncertified
periodic: finite per-cell energy; actual cell/electron/AO/model metadata
actual GDF/grid settings and unit/energy zero retained; no pure k or basis convergence claim
No new independent high-accuracy material benchmark this experiment

independence: W2 INCOMPLETE; two PySCF paths are not independent physical engines. No physical accuracy certification from SCF flags.
autonomy_target: A1 Work-AI observation-conditioned choice. A2 and A3 remain NOT_PROVEN; a string actor or non-empty transcript path is not proof of AI authorship.
ai_authorship_test: Retain actual model-generated decision transcript and hashes, prior read event, competing candidates, frozen request before dispatch
Evaluator checks the second decision was generated after actual first Observation and is justified by concrete values/uncertainties
No hidden optimizer, prewritten second input, human-selected second action or fixture may count as AI exploration
Software verifies binding and ordering only; semantic/authorship acceptance requires B-Chat/Human trace review

classification.PASS: Both domains actually calculated through one Session; two observable semantics preserved; actual feedback-conditioned second decision/action or scientifically justified STOP; full evidence and trace review accepted. If only one domain calculated, no full cross-domain Birth PASS.
classification.VALID_STOP: AI reads a real first result then justified STOP; valid bounded decision evidence but cross-domain World Birth remains INCOMPLETE if second domain never calculated. Not an execution failure by itself.
classification.PARTIAL: Valid local observations/feedback but both-domain or trace/uncertainty evidence incomplete
classification.FAIL: Unauthorized execution, semantic invalidity, fabricated/rewritten physical evidence, invalid binding, or concealment of fixture/scripted actor
classification.INCOMPLETE: Admission blocked, native failure, nonconvergence, timeout/OOM or missing trace; keep all completed results. Failed physical forecast is separate from software/world-capability verdict.

resource_precheck: Static molecular AO/ERI scale and prior Ne runtime only support plausibility. Actual Docker/cgroup/network/versions and current public-standard-free conditions remain launch admission.
failure_policy: Persist intent/parent/solver logs/partial return; stop after any native/scientific failure. No timeout/OOM/SIGSEGV auto rerun or changing thresholds.
engineering_fix_scope: Before scientific authorization: isolated software/schema/host fixes with QA and new frozen source hash. After attempt consumed: evidence collection/reporting only; another scientific try needs separate decision and is not granted here.
human_gate: Accept/reject repaired E00 audit separately from original frozen PASS
Approve publication source manifest and dynamic non-sensitive requests/results on proposed independent branch
Approve domain envelope and up to2 sequential public standard Ubuntu Jobs with above exact limits
Authorize actual Work AI to choose within envelope and choose STOP; do not preselect second coordinates
Require runtime/free-cost check and stop if not proved
central_sync: No central ACK inferred; reporting status recorded separately
stop_after: This preparation stops at Human Review. A future authorized experiment stops after<=2 attempts; no next Foundation/Core/mission change.
